_This is an English translation of the German instructions on withdrawal (Widerrufsbelehrung). The contract language is German, and only the German text is binding._

# Instructions on withdrawal

A consumer is any natural person who enters into a legal transaction for purposes that can predominantly be attributed neither to their trade or business nor to their self-employed professional activity.

As a consumer, you have the following right of withdrawal for contracts you conclude with bootstrap academy GmbH via bootstrap.academy. Part A applies to services: Premium, refilling the hearts and the free user account. Part B applies to the purchase of MorphCoins, that is, of prepaid credit. The purchase of MorphCoins and an order for Premium or for a heart refill are each separate contracts, each with its own right of withdrawal. For earlier orders for courses, webinars and coaching sessions, the instructions on withdrawal you received at the time apply. After that, we explain when the right of withdrawal expires early, which declarations you make when you order and how we make refunds. You will find the model withdrawal form at the end of this page.

## Part A – Instructions on withdrawal for services

(Premium, heart refill and the free user account)

### Right of withdrawal

You have the right to withdraw from this contract within 14 days without giving any reason.

The withdrawal period will expire after 14 days from the day of the conclusion of the contract.

To exercise the right of withdrawal, you must inform us (bootstrap academy GmbH, Wittelsbacherplatz 1, 80333 München, Telephone: +49 30 21928640, Email: hallo@bootstrap.academy) of your decision to withdraw from this contract by an unequivocal statement (e.g. a letter sent by post or email). You may use the attached model withdrawal form, but it is not obligatory. You can also exercise your right of withdrawal online at https://bootstrap.academy/vertrag-widerrufen. If you use this online feature, we will send you an acknowledgement of receipt of the withdrawal on a durable medium (e.g. by email), including its content and the date and time of its submission, without undue delay.

To meet the withdrawal deadline, it is sufficient for you to send your communication concerning your exercise of the right of withdrawal before the withdrawal period has expired.

### Effects of withdrawal

If you withdraw from this contract, we shall reimburse to you all payments received from you, including the costs of delivery (with the exception of the supplementary costs resulting from your choice of a type of delivery other than the least expensive type of standard delivery offered by us), without undue delay and in any event not later than 14 days from the day on which we are informed about your decision to withdraw from this contract. We will carry out such reimbursement using the same means of payment as you used for the initial transaction, unless you have expressly agreed otherwise; in any event, you will not incur any fees as a result of such reimbursement. If you requested to begin the performance of services during the withdrawal period, you shall pay us an amount which is in proportion to what has been provided until you have communicated us your withdrawal from this contract, in comparison with the full coverage of the contract.

## End of the instructions on withdrawal – additional information

The following information is not part of the statutory model instructions on withdrawal. Here we explain, in accordance with Article 246a section 1 (3) of the Introductory Act to the German Civil Code (EGBGB), when your right of withdrawal ends early and how we process your withdrawal.

## Early expiry of the right of withdrawal

Services (Part A): For a contract for the provision of a service in return for payment of a price, the right of withdrawal expires when the service has been provided in full, if, before provision began, you expressly agreed that we begin providing the service before the withdrawal period ends, and you acknowledged that you are aware that your right of withdrawal expires once we have performed the contract in full (section 356 (5) no. 2 of the German Civil Code, BGB). For a contract for a free service, the right of withdrawal expires when we have provided the service in full (section 356 (5) no. 1 BGB).

For a single Premium order whose period starts before the withdrawal period ends, you use a checkbox to request that Premium starts this early. In doing so, you do not confirm that you know you will lose your right of withdrawal early. For this reason, we do not treat your right of withdrawal as expired merely because the service has been provided in full. Premium has been provided in full only when the period actually made available to you has ended. Compensation for the value of services already provided is governed by the statutory requirements and by the refund information below. Besides withdrawing, you can delete the free user account at any time (clause 4.2 of the terms and conditions).

MorphCoins (Part B) and heart refill (Part A): For these, we do not require you to request an early start or to confirm that you know you will lose your right of withdrawal early. We still deliver immediately: after the contract confirmation, for MorphCoins after receipt of your payment has been verified, and at the latest within the period stated in the offer. This does not make your right of withdrawal expire early; you keep it for the full 14 days. Neither crediting the coins to your balance nor using them ends your right of withdrawal. Provision that is still outstanding is not treated as already provided. Independently of the right of withdrawal, we refund unused purchased MorphCoins to you at any time on request (clause 6.7 of the terms and conditions).

## Declarations when you order

For single orders for MorphCoins, a Premium period or a heart refill, you accept the specific offer, including its terms and conditions and these instructions on withdrawal, by clicking "Order with obligation to pay" (in German: „Zahlungspflichtig bestellen“). There is no checkbox for accepting the offer.

Only for a Premium order whose period starts before the withdrawal period ends do you first make the following declaration via a checkbox. If the period starts only after the withdrawal period has ended, because a paid Premium period is still running, there is no checkbox. We store the wording actually used together with the order and the time it was received, and we repeat it in the contract confirmation.

„Ich verlange ausdrücklich, dass das bestellte Premium schon vor Ablauf der Widerrufsfrist von 14 Tagen startet. Widerrufe ich, zahle ich nur den Anteil des Preises für die Tage, an denen dieses Premium bis zu meinem Widerruf schon lief.“

In English: "I expressly request that the Premium I have ordered starts before the 14-day withdrawal period ends. If I withdraw, I pay only the share of the price for the days on which this Premium had already been running up to my withdrawal."

When you buy MorphCoins or refill the hearts, you make no declaration regarding the right of withdrawal.

An automatic Premium renewal is a separate order. We show you its specific declarations and conditions before you order it, and we confirm the declarations you actually made. A single order does not switch on automatic renewal. Earlier orders keep the documents and declarations actually agreed for them; this version does not replace them retroactively.

## Refunds after a withdrawal

- MorphCoins and heart refill: You owe no compensation for value, because you do not request an early start for these orders; we refund the full price. If you withdraw from a purchase of MorphCoins, we remove the coins from that purchase that are still in your balance; for coins you have already spent, the next point applies.

- If you withdraw from a purchase of MorphCoins and have already spent coins from it on Premium or a heart refill, you are no longer bound by those orders either (section 360 BGB); you do not need to withdraw from them separately. To determine what you paid for an order with, reward coins count as used first (clause 6.1 of the terms and conditions), followed by purchased MorphCoins in the sequence in which you bought them. We refund the euro amount of the withdrawn coin purchase via the payment method you used for it. We deduct something from it only for Premium, and only if you requested the early start: the share of the Premium price for the days on which this Premium had already been running up to your withdrawal (section 357a (2) BGB). This Premium ends with the withdrawal. If such an order was paid only partly with coins from this purchase, we refund the remaining part of its price to you under clause 6.8 of the terms and conditions. We refund the same amount only once, and you receive a statement from us that lets you follow the calculation.

- Services that began at your request before the withdrawal period ended: You pay the share that corresponds to the services provided up to your withdrawal (section 357a (2) BGB); we refund the rest.

- Means of payment: We refund a purchase of MorphCoins via the payment method you paid with. Services you paid for with purchased MorphCoins are refunded, as you choose, in MorphCoins or in euros at the rate at which you bought them (100 MorphCoins = €1.00); services you paid for with reward coins are refunded in reward coins (clause 6.8 of the terms and conditions).

- We make the refund without undue delay, and at the latest within 14 days of receiving your withdrawal.
